name: youtube-history-cleaner
description: Chrome extension (MV3) that bulk-removes items from your YouTube watch history by category, keyword and date range, or just finds and highlights them.
author: Pandelis Manikas

scripts.zip: rm -f youtube-history-cleaner.zip && zip -r -X youtube-history-cleaner.zip manifest.json popup src icons -x '*.DS_Store' && unzip -l youtube-history-cleaner.zip
